summary: Preserved the candidate's per-DP/TP/PP Mooncake SSD directory layout and corrected the registered MooncakeDirectLinker path to propagate the runtime attention DP rank. Documented that Mooncake local-disk storage supports one client per final directory and that SGLang treats ssd_offload_path as a base for embedded per-rank directories.

tests.what_was_measured: The exact candidate's three original path tests passed, confirming its valid legacy-controller DP/TP/PP isolation and unset-path boundary.
Two direct-linker-shaped configs omitted DP identity, both retained dp_rank=0, and both selected the same rank_0_0_0 directory; the distinct-path assertion failed.
Four tests passed after correction, including direct-linker propagation of attention DP rank plus DP/TP/PP path and unset-path boundaries.
All applicable repository formatting, lint, safety, and test-registration checks passed.

gpu_evidence: One AMD Instinct MI355X gfx950 GPU was visible through torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2. No GPU execution was claimed because the defect and correction are Python rank propagation and setup-path selection; GPU execution would not validate the missing identity.
remaining_limitations: DeepSeek-V4-Flash weights and the reported TP8 multi-rank deployment were unavailable, so no full model or distributed workload was claimed.

No live Mooncake master with simultaneous LOCAL_DISK clients was run; deterministic setup-path tests validate the SGLang collision precondition and correction, not bucket corruption or restart recovery.
The Mooncake-side recovery/ownership change referenced by the issue was outside this repository and was not qualified.
